name: Haus Gertrud
beschreibung:
Quietly located in Nesselwaengle, Haus Gertrud features comfortable rooms with striking vistas of the Rote Flueh and Gimpel climbing peaks. It is a fantastic hub for hikers and alpine enthusiasts.

The Krinnenalpbahn lift, Lake Haldensee, and cross-country tracks are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Gertrud in Nesselwaengle provides sunny relaxation at the entrance to the Tannheimer Tal valley.
